Guidelines for Enzyme Linked Immunoassay (ELISA) Kits | As a critical tool for disease diagnosis, therapeutic development, and biomedical research, ELISA standardization will improve accuracy, reproducibility, and large-scale testing efficiency.
General Requirements for Cell Samples Transport | This standard covers carriers, transport containers, label management, transport monitoring, and emergency response. The unified specifications ensure quality and safety in cell transport.
